WHOOP_CLIENT_ID.description: From your WHOOP developer app ([create one](https://developer-dashboard.whoop.com/apps/create)). Leave empty if you use Oura. You can also add it later — the `/setup` page shows how.

WHOOP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: From the same WHOOP developer app. Leave empty if you use Oura.

OURA_CLIENT_ID.description: From your Oura application ([create one](https://cloud.ouraring.com/oauth/applications)). Leave empty if you use WHOOP.

OURA_CLIENT_SECRET.description: From the same Oura application. Leave empty if you use WHOOP.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: From a Google Cloud OAuth client of type Web application. You can add it later — the `/setup` page shows how.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: From the same Google Cloud OAuth client.
